queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, s.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_avg_diff
  FROM status_avg s
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_modindex,
  above_avg_diff,
  avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;
WITH status_avg AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS mean_avg FROM status_avg
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_mod, o.mean_avg
  FROM status_avg s, overall o
  WHERE s.avg_mod > o.mean_avg
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_mod AS avg_modindex,
  avg_mod - mean_avg AS diff_from_overall_mean,
  avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;

SELECT

  avg_mod - overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg,
  avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean

WITH status_avg AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_mod, o.overall_avg
  FROM status_avg s
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE s.avg_mod > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_mod AS average_modindex,
  (avg_mod - overall_avg) * 100.0 / overall_avg AS pct_above_overall_average,
  avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;
